channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula fala de 'amor à primeira vista' com Trump e descarta interferência dele nas eleições
item.description: President Lula met with Donald Trump in Washington to discuss key issues including organized crime, critical minerals, tariffs, and trade, describing their rapport as 'love at first sight' while ruling out any interference by Trump in Brazil's 2026 elections. The meeting takes place amid domestic challenges for both leaders in their respective countries.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo diz que Zema é desqualificado e critica ideia de vender o BB
item.description: Aldo Rebelo (DC) criticized Romeu Zema (Novo) as 'uninformed' and 'unqualified' for advocating the privatization of Brazilian state-owned enterprises like Banco do Brasil and Petrobras, warning that such sales could transfer strategic national assets to foreign entities, particularly Chinese state-owned enterprises due to their superior financial capacity. Rebelo argued Brazil cannot afford this 'stupidity' and defended maintaining state control over strategic companies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro age para ligar escândalo do Master ao PT e pressiona por CPI
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used social media to directly link the Banco Master scandal to the PT, pressuring for a CPI to investigate the financial institution and its alleged ties to the party’s national and Bahian leadership, without mentioning Ciro Nogueira, a Bolsonaro ally and PF investigation target. He noted that the PT refused to sign the CPI request while the opposition supported it, implying fear of what might be uncovered.

item.title: Lançamento de plataforma gratuita de streaming do MinC só depende da agenda de Lula
item.description: The free streaming platform from Brazil's Ministry of Culture, named Tela Brasil, has faced repeated delays since its planned November 2024 launch. Its implementation depends solely on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's agenda, according to sources. The project aims to democratize access to Brazilian cultural content but remains without a confirmed release date.

item.title: Penduricalhos: STF manda registrar em contracheque único e veta manobras
item.description: The STF ruled that all public servant payments, including allowances and benefits, must be recorded in a single payslip and published on Transparency Portals. The decision aims to prevent administrative maneuvers that indirectly increase salaries, such as reclassifications of positions or jurisdictions, and ordered the CNJ and CNMP to standardize indemnity payments nationwide.

item.title: Lula está “caladinho” sobre operação contra Ciro Nogueira, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, criticized Lula's silence regarding the Federal Police operation targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira, claiming without evidence that PT members are involved and that investigations will advance through analysis of phones, laptops, and plea bargains. He likened the case to a 'metastasis' and said it will influence the October presidential election.

item.title: Governo renova concessões de distribuição de energia em 13 estados; Enel fica de fora
item.description: The Ministry of Mines and Energy signed early renewals for 14 electricity distribution concessions across 13 states, excluding Enel, which faces a potential concession revocation in São Paulo due to service failures. The new contracts are expected to unlock R$130 billion in investments by 2030 for grid modernization, expansion, and improved consumer service, including stricter financial accountability and pole-sharing regulations. Specific projects include new substations and lines in Bahia, Paraíba, and Sergipe, with President Lula expected to attend the signing ceremony.

item.title: Marketing de Caiado traça estratégia para ampliar eleitorado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) will launch his media campaign in June with TV advertisements aimed at introducing him to the national electorate, emphasizing his achievements in Goiás in economic development, security, and education. The strategy seeks to expand his visibility in the South, North, and Northeast regions, where he is less known, highlighting that his final government approval rating exceeded his 2022 vote share, supporting the message 'the candidate even those who didn’t vote for approve of'.

item.title: Tarcísio defende investigação sobre caso Master: ‘Doa a quem doer’
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas urged for a thorough investigation into the Master Bank case, stating it must be pursued 'no matter who it hurts', despite Senator Ciro Nogueira — a PP ally and Tarcísio-backed Senate pre-candidate — being targeted in the Federal Police operation. He downplayed the postponement of the PP event, emphasizing that his political alliance extends beyond the party to include Republicans, PL, PSD, MDB, Union, and Podemos.

item.title: Lula reforça discurso de combate ao crime organizado após encontro com Trump
item.description: President Lula reinforced his discourse on combating organized crime following a meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, emphasizing international cooperation and the imminent launch of the 'Brazil Against Organized Crime' plan. The plan, targeting the financial structure of criminal factions, will be unveiled next week and integrates intelligence and security force coordination. The initiative comes amid poor public approval of the government's security performance, according to a Ideia poll.

item.title: A investigação que coloca a JBS de Joesley Batista na mira do governo Trump
item.description: The Trump administration is investigating JBS Foods USA and National Food (Brazilian-controlled) for alleged anticompetitive practices in the U.S. meat industry, alongside Cargill and Tyson Foods. The probe coincides with Lula and Trump’s meeting in Washington, though the issue was not formally on the bilateral agenda.

item.title: PT foi contra abertura da CPI do Master, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Workers' Party (PT) of opposing the initiation of a Parliamentary Inquiry Commission (CPI) into the Banco Master case, claiming PT deputies did not sign the request for investigation. He linked the case to alleged benefits for Lula allies, including payments to Jaques Wagner, Guido Mantega, and Lewandowski, and an unofficial meeting between Lula and the bank's owner. Despite these claims, the text notes that the PT later intensified pressure for the CPI's installation amid internal criticism, with leaders like Paulo Pimenta and Pedro Uczai supporting the inquiry.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que suspeitas no caso Master devem ser investigadas, após Ciro Nogueira entrar na mira
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that suspicions in the Banco Master case must be investigated 'no matter who is involved', following a PF search warrant against Senator Ciro Nogueira of the PP, a political ally. He emphasized the investigation should not harm his re-election campaign and noted that PP events were postponed, but affirmed his coalition remains strong with other parties.

item.title: Embraer registra receita recorde no 1º trimestre, apesar das tarifas de Trump
item.description: Embraer reported record revenue of 7.6 billion reais in Q1 2026, driven by strong defense performance, but net profit fell to 145.4 million reais due to lingering U.S. tariffs on machinery, which remain in place despite broader tariff reductions on Brazilian exports. The company announced final assembly of the E175 jet in India and a deal to sell 10–20 C-390 aircraft to the UAE, while President Lula met with Trump to seek tariff relief.

item.title: Como a imprensa americana noticiou o encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: American press highlighted the Lula-Trump meeting as a moment of 'easing tensions' after over a year of diplomatic strain, including tariffs and sanctions. The Wall Street Journal praised the effort for a 'reset' in bilateral relations, citing personal rapport and Trump’s transactional approach as key factors, while the New York Times described it as a 'fragile truce'. The meeting was seen as strategic for Lula, who aims to improve U.S.-Brazil ties without appearing subservient, particularly amid 2026 elections and Bolsonaro clan influence.

item.title: ‘Excelente química’, ‘dinâmico’ e ‘inteligente’: o que Trump já disse sobre Lula
item.description: Trump has repeatedly praised Lula, citing 'excellent chemistry' and describing him as 'dynamic', 'intelligent', and 'a good guy'. Their White House meeting lasted nearly three hours and covered trade and tariffs, with both leaders expressing satisfaction with the bilateral relationship. Despite prior tensions, including sanctions on Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, Trump reversed some measures and signaled interest in deepening ties.

item.title: O recado de Gilberto Kassab sobre a candidatura presidencial de Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, states that Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy is certain, even without coalition allies or TV time, citing Bolsonaro's 2018 election as precedent. He confirms the ticket will include a PSD vice-presidential candidate and that the party will release a series of videos in June to promote Caiado's record in Goiás on economy, security, and education, aiming to reach voters weary of the current political polarization.

item.title: Com rejeição de Messias, duas mulheres ganham força para vaga no STF
item.description: Following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF vacancy, speculation grows over Lula appointing a woman to fill Luís Roberto Barroso's seat. The leading candidates are Daniela Teixeira (STJ minister) and Edilene Lobo (former TSE minister), both previously nominated by Lula and praised for competence, integrity, and representativeness. The administration aims to announce the choice by May, emphasizing judicial excellence and court legitimacy.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Lula x Flávio após caso Messias e encontro com Trump
item.description: The new Quaest poll, set for release on April 13, will measure the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race following recent polls showing the senator’s gains. With 2,004 face-to-face interviews and a 2-point margin of error, it aims to determine whether Bolsonarist momentum has solidified or if the race has stabilized.

item.title: Messi aponta seleções 'à frente' da Argentina para a Copa de 2026 e cita Brasil entre favoritas
item.description: Lionel Messi stated that Argentina is not the main favorite for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, citing France, Brazil, Spain, and Portugal as teams in better form or with strong title chances. He praised France’s continued strength as the 2022 runner-up and acknowledged Brazil’s historical pedigree despite recent instability. Regarding Portugal, he noted it is arriving at one of the most competitive moments in its recent history.

item.title: Governo quer aprovar aumento da mistura do biodiesel no diesel até o fim do ano; testes começam neste mês
item.description: The government aims to approve by the end of 2024 an increase in the mandatory biodiesel blend in diesel from 15% to 16% (B16), with technical tests starting this month, funded by R$30 million from the FNDCT and private contributions. Technical viability is required for the CNPE to deliberate, in line with the Future Fuel Law, which mandates an annual 1-point increase until reaching 20% by 2030. The proposal was reinforced by President Lula’s public endorsement of biodiesel as an accessible renewable fuel.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula enrola com o Desenrola
item.description: Lula relaunched Desenrola 2.0, a debt renegotiation program aimed at helping 27 million Brazilians. The government acknowledges that the original Desenrola, launched in 2023, failed to meet its goals, making this updated version an attempt to correct prior shortcomings. The initiative comes amid electoral pressure and seeks to improve public perception of the government’s financial inclusion efforts.

item.title: Janaína Paschoal quer Tereza Cristina no lugar de Ciro no PP
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Janaína Paschoal (PP-SP) urged that Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) temporarily assume the presidency of the Progressistas party while investigations against Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) in Operation Compliance Zero are ongoing, stating that his removal would not imply guilt but protect public integrity. She emphasized that the PP has capable internal leadership to avoid strengthening the União Brasil party, with which it is federated. The Federal Police launched a new phase of the operation, investigating fraud tied to Banco Master, executing search and seizure warrants and one arrest warrant against Nogueira, including allegations of monthly payments and free use of a luxury property.

item.title: 'Pai do Lulinha': Flávio grava vídeo após operação da PF contra Ciro Nogueira e vincula caso Master ao PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released a video following the PF operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, calling Lula 'father of Lulinha' and linking the PT to the Master case. He accused the PT of opposing the Banco Master CPI, alleging payments to Rui Costa, Jaques Wagner, and Guido Mantega, and claimed the opposition signed the CPI request while the PT blocked it. Flávio also referenced a alleged meeting between Lula and Vorcaro with Rui Costa present and Lewandowski’s consultancy to Master, insisting the CPI must now proceed.

item.title: Fim da 6 X 1 pode acabar com voos internacionais, diz CEO da Latam
item.description: Jerome Jacques Cadier, CEO of LATAM Brazil, warned that ending the 6x1 work schedule in Congress could disrupt international flights over eight hours by including pilots and flight attendants in labor reforms. He advocates excluding aviation workers from the changes, citing a potential 20% rise in operational costs under a 5x2 model. Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) rebutted the claims, mocking the comparison to France’s 35-hour workweek and accusing the executive of shamelessness.

item.title: Operação contra Ciro Nogueira no caso Master é trunfo eleitoral para Lula
item.description: The police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP), tied to Operation Compliance Zero and suspicions of financial fraud linked to Banco Master, is being framed by the Lula government as an electoral advantage. This follows the earlier defeat in the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, with the government seeking to regain political ground by highlighting that the investigation was led by STF Minister André Mendonça, appointed by Bolsonaro, and by implicating key Centrão figures aligned with the opposition, including Nogueira and potential allies of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo apresenta projeto de negociação coletiva após quase duas décadas de espera
item.description: The Lula government sent Bill PL 1.893/2026 to Congress, regulating collective bargaining in the public sector and implementing ILO Convention 151. The bill mandates annual negotiation rounds between government and unions, provides paid leave for union mandates at the federal level, and allows mediation in case of deadlock. However, it omits key demands such as the right to strike and union funding, leading unions and public servants to view it as an incomplete advance.

item.title: Natália Guimarães fala sobre maternidade e aponta virada no Miss Universe Brasil 2026
item.description: Miss Universe Brazil 2026 will feature nine mother candidates, reflecting an evolving definition of beauty and representation. The inclusion of mothers highlights attributes such as maturity, responsibility, and personal transformation, expanding the concept of elegance beyond traditional aesthetic standards. Natália Guimarães, Miss Brazil 2007 and current strategy director of the pageant, states that motherhood enriches a woman’s worldview and that beauty also lies in journey and experience.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Com minerais críticos na pauta, Lula indica a Trump que quem quer rir, tem que fazer rir
item.description: Lula and Trump held a cordial meeting at the White House without concrete agreements, but established working groups to address key issues such as critical minerals and trade disputes. Lula emphasized the value of humor in diplomacy, stating 'whoever wants to laugh must make others laugh,' and affirmed Brazil’s openness to partnerships with multiple countries. Meanwhile, Brazilian Federal Police arrived at the residence of Ciro Nogueira in Brasília, prompting reactions within Flávio Bolsonaro’s circle.

item.title: Após ação da PF mirar Ciro Nogueira, aliado da família Bolsonaro, Flávio tenta ligar Master ao PT da Bahia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) alleged links between Banco Master and the national and Bahian PT, hours after a Federal Police operation at the home of Ciro Nogueira (PP), a Bolsonaro ally, who received up to R$500,000 monthly from bank owner Daniel Vorcaro. He advocated for a CPI (Parliamentary Inquiry Commission) into the bank to investigate alleged irregularities and ties to the Lula administration, particularly in Bahia, where PT governments allegedly facilitated the bank’s operations. Despite efforts since April by opposition and government-aligned lawmakers, the CPI has not yet been established, though a mixed CPMI remains possible.

item.title: Lula termina semana bem na foto
item.description: Although the opposition tried to weaken the government by rejecting Jorge Messias’ STF nomination and overturning the veto on a law reducing penalties for coup plotters, Lula reversed the situation with unexpected support from Donald Trump and André Mendonça, figures admired by Bolsonaro. This alliance allowed the president to regain political ground, turning an apparent setback into a display of strength and negotiation skill.

item.title: Governo prevê R$ 130 bi para novos contratos de energia; Enel em SP não é contemplada
item.description: The Lula government is set to announce R$130 billion in investments for the renewal of electricity distribution contracts with 16 companies, including two that have already been updated. Enel São Paulo was not included in this round of renewals, despite being one of the country's largest distributors.

item.title: Lula ganha atestado de vigor de Trump, o ídolo do bolsonarismo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to attack President Lula by associating him with the image of being 'old' and 'outdated,' but Lula's meeting with Donald Trump in Washington created an unexpected contrast. Trump publicly praised Lula as a 'very dynamic' president, providing an unlikely endorsement from a central figure of Bolsonarism, which undermined Flávio's narrative.

item.title: Encontro entre Lula e Trump superou as expectativas e levou o diálogo a novo patamar
item.description: The meeting between Presidents Lula and Donald Trump exceeded expectations, avoiding the typical awkwardness seen in Trump’s encounters with other world leaders by skipping the press Q&A session. The dialogue was described as productive and elevated Brazil-U.S. bilateral relations to a new level.

item.title: “Orgulho sem tamanho”, diz Janja após encontro de Lula e Trump
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva praised President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, saying she felt 'an immense pride' in his tireless work for Brazil’s advancement and sovereignty defense. The leaders met for about three hours without signing formal agreements, but established working groups to continue negotiations on three key goals: reducing the risk of new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, expanding bilateral cooperation against organized crime, and advancing talks on critical minerals. Despite no formal outcomes, Lula said he left the meeting 'very optimistic'.

item.title: Wellington Fagundes lidera corrida para governo de Mato Grosso
item.description: Senator Wellington Fagundes (PL) leads voting intentions for governor of Mato Grosso in two first-round scenarios, with between 29% and 30.8%, according to a Percent Brasil poll released on May 8, 2026. The survey, conducted between April 30 and May 3 with 1,200 voters, has a margin of error of 2.83 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. Jayme Campos (União Brasil) shows the highest rejection rate at 8.2%, followed by Fagundes at 5.6%.

item.title: Após operação da PF contra Ciro Nogueira, PP adia evento de apoio a Tarcísio
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, national president of the Progressive Party (PP), over alleged involvement in the Banco Master scandal, prompting the party to postpone an event officially endorsing Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) to avoid political damage. Despite the delay, the PP maintains its support for Tarcísio’s re-election, with Guilherme Derrite as its Senate pre-candidate on the ticket. The operation drew criticism from Bolsonaro allies, including Flávio Bolsonaro, who praised STF Minister André Mendonça’s authorization of the warrants.

item.title: Partido de Ciro Nogueira adia evento em que oficializaria apoio a Tarcísio em SP
item.description: The Progressistas (PP) postponed its official event endorsing Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election bid in São Paulo after Senator Ciro Nogueira, the party president, became a target of a Federal Police operation under 'Compliance Zero'. Investigations allege Nogueira received undue advantages from banker Daniel Vorcaro, including monthly payments of up to R$500,000, luxury flights, and a constitutional amendment drafted by Banco Master. Despite the postponement, the PP maintains its support for Tarcísio in the October elections.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio aciona TCU por suspeita de ‘pedalada fiscal’ do governo Lula
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, filed a representation with the TCU alleging that the Lula government committed a 'fiscal pedalada' by withholding Seguro-Defeso payments between September and December 2025 to artificially improve the primary balance. He cites Treasury data showing a negative liquid expense of R$ 6.61 million, contrasting with payments of R$ 1.2 billion in 2023 and R$ 675 million in 2024, along with inconsistencies in the official timeline for transferring management from INSS to the Ministry of Labor.

item.title: Jornal chinês vê reunião de Lula com Trump como positiva à China
item.description: The Chinese state media outlet Global Times praised the meeting between Lula and Trump as positive for China, noting that Lula refused to grant the U.S. preferential access to Brazil's rare earth minerals. A cited expert said Lula resisted U.S. pressure for an exclusive deal, preserving Brazil's strategic autonomy and positioning it as an independent player in the global critical minerals supply chain. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves, crucial for modern technology, and is sought after by both the U.S. and China due to its geographic proximity and resource wealth.

item.title: Mauro Mendes e Janaina Riva lideram corrida ao Senado por MT
item.description: The Percent Brazil poll released on May 8, 2026, shows Mauro Mendes (União Brasil) and Janaina Riva (MDB) leading the Senate race in Mato Grosso with 27.6% and 17% voting intentions, respectively. The survey interviewed 1,200 voters from April 30 to May 3, with a 2.83-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Pedro Taques (PSB) recorded the highest rejection rate at 10.8%.

item.title: Pesquisa eleitoral: o resultado do confronto Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A recent Genial/Quaest survey conducted between April 21 and 28 shows Flávio Bolsonaro numerically leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in São Paulo, Brazil's largest electoral college, highlighting his growing support among São Paulo voters. The poll reveals a deeply polarized regional landscape: Lula maintains strength in the Northeast, while Flávio gains ground in the South and Southeast, with Minas Gerais showing a technical tie. The survey interviewed 11,646 voters across 562 municipalities and has a two-point margin of error in São Paulo.

item.title: Reunião com Trump e operação contra Ciro dão ânimo a pré-campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's meeting with Donald Trump at the White House and the Federal Police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, boosted the president's pre-campaign. These events were seen as political gains that energize Lula's base and weaken opposition coordination. The action against Nogueira, PP leader in the Senate, is viewed as a strategic blow to a key figure in Bolsonarism.

item.title: Congresso tem seus problemas, mas evitou estrago maior de Lula
item.description: Congress defeated President Lula in two key votes: it overturned his veto on the dosimetry bill and rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court. Despite criticism from the PT and its digital militias, Congress avoided greater institutional damage by asserting its independence from the Executive.

item.title: Trump diz que Lula é 'inteligente' e um 'bom homem' após encontro na Casa Branca
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump praised Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following a three-hour meeting at the White House, calling him a 'good man' and 'intelligent'. Trump described the meeting as 'great' to reporters.

item.title: O movimento de Lula e as investigações que podem complicar Davi Alcolumbre na PF
item.description: Lula's ministers, José Múcio Monteiro and José Guimarães, met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to assure him that Lula bears no responsibility for ongoing Federal Police investigations into him, which involve Banco Master, INSS, and the Carbono Oculto operation. Despite promising a reconciliation meeting with Lula, Alcolumbre remains skeptical, claiming he will be targeted for retaliation by the PT following Jorge Messias's defeat in the STF selection. Investigations against Alcolumbre, previously low-priority, have intensified due to increased questioning of informants.

item.title: Ativismo judicial do Congresso Nacional
item.description: The text criticizes the frequent accusation of judicial activism against the STF, arguing it is often used as political rhetoric to delegitimize unfavorable decisions without technical basis. It proposes that true judicial activism is shifting to the Legislature, particularly in the INSS and Organized Crime CPIs, which exercise judicial powers without respecting legality, procedures, or STF rulings, thus constituting congressional judicial activism that violates the separation of powers.

item.title: Governo promulga acordo de facilitação do comércio do Mercosul
item.description: The Brazilian government promulgated the Mercosul Trade Facilitation Agreement, signed in 2019 by Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay, aiming to deepen regional integration through simplified intrabloc trade mechanisms. The agreement, approved by the National Congress in 2023 and ratified by Paraguay in 2024, builds on the Treaty of Asunción and the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement, seeking to overcome the bloc’s historical shortcomings, including partial harmonization of the common external tariff and exceptions to free movement of goods.

item.title: PF prende sogra do governador de GO por esquema de migração ilegal
item.description: Federal Police arrested Maria Helena de Sousa Netto Costa, mother-in-law of Goiás Governor Daniel Vilela, in Operation Travessia, which dismantled an illegal migration scheme to the U.S. moving R$240 million between 2018 and 2023. She is suspected of leading a group that moved R$45 million and organized the irregular crossing of at least 477 Brazilians into the United States. The governor and his wife are not targets of the investigation.

item.title: Após ‘passar pano’ para Ciro Nogueira, Flávio cobra instalação de CPI do Banco Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President, took to social media to demand the installation of the Banco Master CPI, after being widely criticized for issuing a formal statement about the ties between former Minister Ciro Nogueira and banker Daniel Vorcaro. His move is seen as an attempt to distance himself from accusations of ‘giving a pass’ to Bolsonaro allies, while politically capitalizing on the Banco Master scandal.
